about: The known, tracked gaps of the actor record audit (tools/actor_record_audit.py, docs/ACTOR_RECORDS.md 'Is it all there: the audit'). tests/test_actor_record_audit.py fails when docs/actor-record-audit.json shows a field with missing or different records that is not listed here, or more of them than listed. A gap that closes lowers its number here in the same commit. Each entry names its tracker or register ID.

inventory levelled.why: levelled inventory resolved once at build time; the original picks per actor

wander.why: Wander packages of actors placed only in the expansions' cells are not compiled (6 references in Morrowind.esm)

ranged weapon.why: since v0.0.66 a bow, crossbow or thrown weapon is held when it rates highest at the opening of a fight (OpenMW weaponpriority.cpp); missing: a bow or crossbow without its ammunition (the original rates it 0); different: a melee weapon rated higher at the opening (the original switches to the bow at range during the fight, not yet done), or a levelled list whose one build-time pick gives a melee weapon only (ACTOR-LEVELLED-INVENTORY-ONE-PICK-66). Measured on the v0.0.66-dev2 build (BUILD-ACTOR-SPEC-EXPANSIONS-66): 52 records, 40 of the base game, 3 of Tribunal, 9 of Bloodmoon (the eight berserkers, whose list bm_randomweapon_berserker gives a melee weapon, and Thauraver, whose glass firesword rates above his throwing knives); the 43 recorded with the ranged change did not include these nine, whose weapon the builder chooses the same at every revision since that change (checked on the same game data)

scale.why: creature scale not held (all placed in the expansions)

armour.why: the one fixed levelled pick gives no armour piece where the list could; shields dropped beside a two-handed weapon

weapon.why: the one fixed levelled pick gives no weapon where the list could

script locals.why: one expansion actor's script compiled with another local count than its record's header (not placed in Morrowind.esm); to look into

weapon and shield flag.why: fixed on v0.0.66: such a creature equips its weapon and armour

anim idle.why: measured on the v0.0.66 release build with the appended creature tables read as the engine plays them (ACTOR-AUDIT-APPENDED-TABLES-66: before, every creature on the humanoid skeleton counted as playing nothing; v0.0.65 counted 561): nearly all are expansion actors that build does not place (Mournhold's districts, Solstheim's exteriors); 4 references in Morrowind.esm

anim knockdown.why: as anim idle, and the storm atronach, which keeps the creature library's six baked groups ('kf'; v0.0.65 counted 770)
